arguments.text: 10 km, 1000 m out-and-back legs. Goal: even effort near true critical power (pod CP 146 W from test, may be 10-25% off), spend the reserve only in the last ~1.5 km. Check CP via heart-rate drift at steady effort (rising HR at steady power = above CP). Watch for incidents: speed loss at same pod power (weed/drag -> clear_rudder), pod drift (pod vs boat/HR disagree), radio messages (course change -> set_race_distance + tell). Final sprint cue around 800-1000 m to go if reserve allows.

t~410s: measure 200-300 (150 W pod) and 300-400 (156 W): HR trend ~0 bpm/min (169-171), so pod CP likely >=150 W. Hull fit share 0.71 (boat CP 95 implies shaft CP 134, inconsistent with pod CP 146; boat reserve 9.2 = 13.0*0.71 consistent). Running CP test piece from ~410s: 180 s +8% (~165 W) then 120 s hold. If HR levels off in 2nd half of +8% => CP >=160; if keeps climbing => CP ~150-158.
